name: BGE-small-en-v1.5 English Embedder
license: BAAI base model MIT; Qdrant/FastEmbed runtime ONNX artifact Apache-2.0
model_source: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (base model); FastEmbed resolves its ONNX runtime artifact from Qdrant/bge-small-en-v1.5-onnx-Q
inference_mode: local ONNX inference via FastEmbed; no embedding API call
corpus_indexed: A small bundled AgriBridge demonstration corpus
limits_and_biases: English-only model; Hindi and Bengali questions use keyword matching when dense embedding results are not suitable. No retrieval benchmark has been published.
intended_use: English dense retrieval over the bundled demonstration passages.
